about: Grades against the papers (ASSISTANT grades, not independent). Arm 1 = c6 + prompt p6 + verifier v4.5c (B12_fix_c6/); arm 2 = c3 + p6 + v4.5c (B12_fix_c3/). Setting B, same 12 questions as B12. Owner-approved cap 90,000 tokens. Groq's daily limit (429, organization token limit) stopped arm 2 at q14; arm 1's q16/q20 were cut by the per-arm 45,000-token cap.
